dataset.provenance_caveat: The distributed archive contains a complete 1..800 orientation set. Ancillary setup scripts contain stale or mixed generation counts; the archive member audit, not those constants, defines this benchmark.

upstream_contract.dilute_algebra: form twelve observables per orientation and sum them incoherently
upstream_contract.packed_algebra: translate each orientation by its structure center, coherently sum four complex amplitudes, then form twelve observables
upstream_contract.normalization: The kernel factor 1/(W*N_avg) cancels the W*N_avg part of the later micromagnetic scaling; physical output factors are therefore applied after the dilute or coherent aggregate.

harmonic_support.selection_rule: for each q and internal particle radius R_i retain |h| <= ceil(q R_i) + 4, capped strictly below angular Nyquist
harmonic_support.reason: Fourier translation is an exact object-level phase and does not enlarge the internal particle bandwidth.

factorization.stage_a: stream one orientation at a time and evaluate its four internal-particle Fourier amplitudes
factorization.stage_b_dilute: form the five primitive observables per orientation, sum, apply physical factors, and derive the remaining seven observables
factorization.stage_b_packed: multiply each orientation amplitude by exp(-i q dot center_k), sum coherently for each of four structure tables, then contract observables
factorization.common_reduction_policy: ACFO and projected type-3 use the identical streaming reduction implementation; reduction is timed separately and added equally to both workflow models.
forbidden_implementations: including packing-center radius in the ACFO harmonic cutoff
materializing the 800 x 4 x 999000 complex amplitude library
comparing streamed ACFO against an unfactorized 3379200-source baseline
tuning mode padding, Miller margin, radial grid, or dispatch threshold after inspecting orientations 2..800

baseline_dispatch.projection: q along the ACFO orbit axis is identically zero, so the third source coordinate is eliminated exactly
baseline_dispatch.plan_reuse: construct one type-3 plan, reuse fixed targets, and include per-orientation setpts plus execute in the streamed orientation cost
ineligible: type-2 NUFFT or Cartesian FFT because the back-rotated active sites are non-Cartesian
analytic h=0 reduction because individual orientation amplitudes are not axisymmetric
full 3-D type-3 as the primary baseline because exact planar projection is available

prospective_dispatch.frozen_primary_rule: select projected type-3 for K < 50 and ACFO for K >= 50 on the fixed RTX 3090 cold-process workload, provided all qualification gates pass
prospective_dispatch.packing_invariance_prediction: The selected Fourier backend is identical for all five packing cases because packing changes only the exact common reduction stage.

crossover.primary_axis: number K of streamed orientations in archive order
reported_crossovers: first strict warm-process favorable integer K
first strict cold-process favorable integer K including one GPU Miller JIT
first persistent favorable integer K for each definition

accuracy.direct_target_rule: unique evenly spaced flattened detector indices including both endpoints
accuracy.secondary_reason: The public files are single-precision and include upstream physical scaling and CSV formatting; the direct and projected-type3 gates isolate operator accuracy more cleanly.

timing_and_statistics.warmup_contract: repeat orientation 1 for each Fourier arm after plan construction; exclude these executions from setup, per-orientation timing, reductions, and all gates; matches the prior orientation-1 pilot and was fixed before any public orientation 2 timing
timing_and_statistics.paired_order: AB for odd orientation index and BA for even orientation index
timing_and_statistics.primary_speedup: ratio of total projected-type3 Fourier time to total ACFO Fourier time at K=800
timing_and_statistics.dispatch_score: fraction of frozen prefix decisions whose sign matches measured setup-inclusive cumulative time
timing_and_statistics.unfavorable_result_policy: preserve and report; do not refit the threshold
